title: Bee Removal in New Hyde Park
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee nest removal in New Hyde Park, Long Island. Licensed technicians. Call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote.
intro: The Best Pest Control NYC provides expert stinging insect nest treatment and removal throughout New Hyde Park, addressing the unique challenges faced by homeowners and businesses in this historic Long Island community. Our licensed technicians remove wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, and ground bee nests from residential properties, commercial buildings, and the charming older homes that characterize this Nassau County neighborhood. We offer transparent, affordable nest removal solutions that protect your property and eliminate the threat of repeated stinging.
whyUs: Our team has extensive experience serving New Hyde Park's diverse mix of Tudor-style homes, garden apartments, and commercial properties along Hillside Avenue and Jericho Turnpike. We understand local building structures and provide same-day or next-day service to quickly address bee infestations before they become more serious problems.
localContext: New Hyde Park's tree-lined streets, mature gardens, and proximity to parks like Herricks Pond Park create ideal habitats for wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets seeking nesting sites. The area's mix of pre-war homes with wooden siding, attic spaces, and vinyl-sided split-levels often provide perfect locations for paper wasp nests, bald-faced hornet nests, and yellow jacket colonies to establish themselves in wall voids, soffits, eaves, and chimneys. Carpenter bees bore into the exposed wood trim and fascia boards common on older homes, while ground-nesting yellow jackets colonize lawn edges and garden beds.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove a wasp or hornet nest from my New Hyde Park home?
faqs.answer: We typically provide same-day or next-day service to New Hyde Park residents. Once you contact us at (855) 930-5016, we'll schedule service within 24 hours and can often perform the nest treatment and removal immediately if the situation requires urgent attention. Our proximity to Nassau County allows us to respond quickly to all stinging insect nest removal requests.

faqs.question: What does the wasp and hornet nest removal service include?
faqs.answer: Our service includes a thorough inspection to locate the nest entrance, direct treatment of the nest through the entry point, removal of accessible nest material, and sealing of entry points to prevent recolonization. Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in New Hyde Park?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: Are wasp and hornet nests common in New Hyde Park homes?
faqs.answer: Yes, New Hyde Park's abundance of flowering gardens, mature trees, and older homes with attic vents and wall gaps make it attractive to wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets seeking nesting sites. Spring and early summer are peak seasons for nest-building activity. The area's mix of architectural styles, especially homes with wooden elements, soffit overhangs, and chimney structures, can provide ideal locations for paper wasp, bald-faced hornet, and yellow jacket nest establishment.
